text: Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
author: George Addair

text: Accept responsibility for your life. Know that it is you who will get you where you want to go, no one else.
author: Les Brown

text: Too many of us are not living our dreams because we are living our fears.
author: Les Brown

text: Your worst enemy cannot harm you as much as your own thoughts unguarded.
author: Buddha

text: In the depth of winter, I finally learned that within me there lay an invincible summer.
author: Albert Camus

text: It's the possibility of having a dream come true that makes life interesting.
author: Paulo Coelho

text: Happiness is not something ready made. It comes from your own actions.
author: Dalai Lama

text: I have been impressed with the urgency of doing. Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Being willing is not enough; we must do.
author: Leonardo da Vinci

text: The most difficult thing is the decision to act; the rest is merely tenacity.
author: Amelia Earhart

text: Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value.
author: Albert Einstein

text: Insist on yourself; never imitate.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: When everything seems to be going against you, remember that the airplane takes off against the wind, not with it.
author: Henry Ford

text: Whether you think you can or you think you can't, you're right.
author: Henry Ford

text: In three words I can sum up everything I've learned about life: It goes on.
author: Robert Frost

text: Whatever you can do, or dream you can, begin it. Boldness has genius, power and magic in it.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

text: Build your own dreams, or someone else will hire you to build theirs.
author: Farrah Gray

text: There is nothing noble in being superior to your fellow man; true nobility is being superior to your former self.
author: Ernest Hemingway

text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
author: Steve Jobs

text: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
author: Steve Jobs

text: Change is the law of life and those who look only to the past or present are certain to miss the future.
author: John F. Kennedy

text: Our lives begin to end the day we become silent about things that matter.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.

text: If you don't change your direction, you may end up where you are going.
author: Lao Tzu

text: When I let go of what I am, I become what I might be.
author: Lao Tzu

text: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: Action is the foundational key to all success.
author: Pablo Picasso

text: Failure is not the opposite of success; it is a stepping stone towards it.
author: Sundar Pichai

text: Change brings opportunity.
author: Nido Qubein

text: The question isn't who is going to let me; it's who is going to stop me.
author: Ayn Rand

text: Remember no one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

text: The best revenge is massive success.
author: Frank Sinatra

text: Whenever you find yourself on the side of the majority, it is time to pause and reflect.
author: Mark Twain

text: Twenty years from now you will be more disappointed by the things that you didn't do than by the ones you did do. So throw off the bowlines. Sail away from the safe harbor. Catch the trade winds in your sails. Explore. Dream. Discover.
author: Mark Twain

text: I would rather die of passion than of boredom.
author: Vincent van Gogh

text: We are products of our past, but we don't have to be prisoners of it.
author: Rick Warren

text: If you want to lift yourself up, lift up someone else.
author: Booker T. Washington
